core_memory.diagnosis: Type 2 Diabetes diagnosed 10 years ago. Required diet and lifestyle changes. Regular blood sugar monitoring. Doctor guidance has been helpful.
core_memory.diet_changes: Swapped sugary snacks and refined carbs for whole grains, lean proteins, and vegetables. Current meals: Greek yogurt with nuts/berries for breakfast, grilled chicken salad for lunch, and homemade vegetable soups for dinner during colder months.
core_memory.lifestyle_changes: Low-impact routine: 30-min walks, yoga 2-3x/week, stationary bike on bad weather days, home exercises. Focus on consistency, joint health, and weather-adaptive activities.
core_memory.stress_management: Practice morning mindfulness(5 min deep breathing/meditation) and maintain gratitude journal to track daily positives. Helps manage stress and hypertension.
core_memory.hydration_practices: Prioritize water intake with a bottle throughout the day, herbal teas in the evening instead of coffee, increase consumption during hot Kansas summers for energy, digestion, and skin health.
core_memory.preventative_care: Regular check-ups, medications on time, annual vaccines(flu, pneumonia, RSV), mammograms, bone density monitoring due to family history of osteoporosis. Focus on early detection of health issues.
core_memory.motivation_approach: Embrace consistency over perfection, practice self-compassion on off days, focus on gradual progress rather than strict adherence. Prioritize sustainable habits over rigid self-discipline.
